scope: what the main thread is waiting on
tool: tools/client_wait.py (reads dwords near the window thread ESP, NtQueryObject for type/name)

interpretation.timer_wait: the main thread is parked in a timer wait (IRTimer), which is the normal frame-rate sleep of the engine loop -- it is not deadlocked, it simply does not call the network read path any more
interpretation.consequence: the 'one message only' symptom is not a blocked thread: the upper layer stops invoking the message reader. The client's frame loop is alive but the game code that would read packets (the network pump inside CL_Frame/CL_ReadPacket) is no longer reached after the gamestate.
